Installing GenStone Over Steel Building Siding
Measure • Cut with Any Saw • Attach with Screws

Starting at any corner of your metal building siding, cut 1″ x 2″ furring strips to the height of your GenStone install. Attach the furring strips to your steel building siding with construction adhesive and self-tapping screws. This will create a level installation surface and bridge the gap between the high ribs.

Installation Considerations
GenStone Siding for Steel Buildings

Installing GenStone over existing metal building siding is basically the same process outlined in our step by step installation videos featuring Zach and Amanda from our support team.

What Size Wall?

GenStone can completely cover your metal building siding or partially cover the siding in the form of a wainscot or skirting project. If you choose to partially cover your steel building siding, closure strips will be required to ensure a weatherproof install.

Closure Strips

Metal or neoprene closure strips can be purchased from your local hardware store or through your metal building siding supplier. Closure strips are installed along the top row of any partial wall of GenStone in order to close the gap between the metal ribs and the back of the GenStone panels.

No matter where you are in the process of building, we can show you what GenStone siding would look like on your metal building.

- New Build: Send us anything from a wireframe to full renderings of your steel building system.

- Existing Buildings: All we need is a picture(s) of the wall(s) you would like to upgrade with GenStone.

Request a no obligation rendering showing any or all of our stone or brick styles. We can even tell you how much GenStone you would need to complete your project and deliver a customized quote in just a few minutes.

Composition and Quality
Backed by Our Industry Leading 25 Year Warranty

All GenStone products are cast from real stone and tumbled brick before being finished by hand, with 12 coats of premium exterior paint in a factory-controlled setting. Our proprietary foam formula contains enhancers that deliver unmatched durability, UV resistance, and a lightweight material that’s easy to install on your own.
